body:
I was up at my cabin recording music.  I had some MJ and some methylone and some oxycodone.
I took some oxycodone (only half a pill... nothing major at all) and smoked some weed.  I then busted open the Methylone and started dabbing it.  I am experienced with many chemicals and have a good idea of tolerance and 'over-doing it.'
About 1 hour after I took the last bit of Methylone, I was sitting at my desk and suddenly, out of nowhere, had a sensation of dying.  I was in extreme panic and felt like my heart was gunna explode and my brain started tingling.  I felt for sure that I was going to die.
I went to the ER with extreme high blood pressure and elevated heart rate. I was given IV fluids and all my bloodwork was normal.  I stayed for 3 hours and they let me go home.
It is now day 3 and I feel no different. I feel like I am still dealing with major issues affecting my life in hardcore ways.
I feel like I am still dealing with major issues affecting my life in hardcore ways.
It still feels like the Methylone is in my body -- my gut, heart and brain -- and I am constantly dealing with fatigue, dizziness, brain tingling and overall weakness.
It is by 10000000000 miles the most insane, toxic and terrifying experience of my life.  I am not sure why I feel so incredibly sick from this stuff, but I do... 100%.
I hope to get back to normal hopefully...
[Reported Dose: "Not sure 1g"]
